summary: Petitioner seeks juvenility verification for offence dated 10.09.1982. Medical Board report (age ~15 in 1982) and Family Register (birth year 1968) imply age ~14–15 at offence. Court directs age determination by Juvenile Justice Board/Ddistrict Judges; reports due within two months; directs legal aid; prohibits lodging of prisoners below 18 in adult prisons; discusses applicability of the Juvenile Justice Act, 2000 and amendments (Amendment Act 2011; Amendment Act No. 33 of 2006) and related Rules.
legal_provisions_cited: Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2000 – Section 2(l)
Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2000 – proviso to Section 7A(1)
Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Rules, 2007
Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Amendment Act, 2011
Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2000 – Amendment Act No. 33 of 2006
Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2000 – Section 15
final_judgment: Court directed age verification for juvenility through Sessions Court/Juvenile Justice Board, with reports to be submitted on the next listing and within two months; mandated legal aid for prisoners; directed that prisoners below 18 years of age should not be lodged in adult prisons; considered applicability of the Juvenile Justice Act, 2000 and amendments.
